signals.description: Tämä ei ole hankintailmoitus eikä tarjouspyyntö, vaan tietopyyntö, jolla Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialue pyytää järjestelmätoimittajia ilmoittautumaan mahdollista kilpailutusta varten. Kyseessä on tietopyyntö/markkinakartoitus, jolla Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialue kartoittaa mahdollisia palveluntoimittajia asiakaspalautejärjestelmän toimittajaksi. Markkinakartoituksen avulla hyvinvointialue pyrkii: 1. Saamaan tietoa markkinoiden tarjonnasta ja eri toimittajien ratkaisuista 2. Mahdolliset integraatioiden toteutus eri alustoille tai järjestelmiin 3. Arvioimaan tietoturvan ja tietosuojan toteutusta 4. Saamaan yleiskuvan hinnoittelumalleista ja kustannusrakenteista (ei yksittäisiä tarjouksia) 5. Kartoittamaan toimitus- ja palvelumalleja Markkinavuoropuhelu on avoin kaikille toimittajille, joilla on tarjota tämän ratkaisukokonaisuuden piiriin kuuluvia ratkaisuista. Vuoropuhelun painopisteenä ovat ratkaisut, jotka ovat jo tuotannossa. Toimittajia pyydetään esittelemään palveluita, jotka ovat käytettävissä ja joissa keskeiset toiminnallisuudet ovat valmiiksi toteutettuja. Kehitteillä olevien tai vasta konseptitasolla olevien ratkaisujen esittelyistä Toimittajan on erikseen mainittava toimittamassaan esitteessä sekä annettava arvio mahdollisesta toteutuksen ajankohdasta. Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialue toivoo esityksiä seuraavista ratkaisuista: Käyttötarkoitus ja -ympäristö Järjestelmän tulee soveltua hyvinvointialueen käyttöön seuraavien sote-, pela-palveluiden palautteiden keräämiseen ja hallintaan. - Puhelinpalvelu - Palvelupisteessä asiointi - Sähköinen asiointi Järjestelmän tulee myös mahdollistaa kansallisen asiakaspalautteen keruu Terveyden ja hyvinvoinnin laitoksen (THL) määrittelyjen mukaisesti. Käyttäjäryhmiä ovat: - Hyvinvointialueen työntekijät (johtajat, esihenkilöt) Keskeiset toiminnallisuudet Asianhallinta - Palautetiedon käsittely - Vastaaminen palautteeseen järjestelmän kautta Tekstiviestipalaute - Kahdensuuntainen tekstiviesti - Selainpohjainen tekstiviestikysely - Kyselyn lähetyksen esto henkilöille, jotka ovat kieltäneet viestin lähettämisen Verkkopalaute - Selainpohjainen kysely Koosteet/raportit - Automatisoidut koosteet luvitetuille henkilöille Palautelaitteet - fyysiset palaute laitteet Tekoäly - Palautedatan analysointi, nostojen ja trendien muodostaminen - Interaktiivinen palaute Integraatiot - Tietojen vienti ja raportointi (Tietoallas) - Käyttäjätunnusten hallinnointi Entra ID:n kautta (hyvinvointialueen työntekijät, jotka käsittelevät palautteita) - Mahdolliset integraatiot potilas- ja asiakastietotietojärjestelmä Tekniset vaatimukset - Pilvipohjainen SaaS-ratkaisu - Suomenkielinen käyttöliittymä - Saavutettavuusdirektiivin mukainen toteutus - Jatkuva ylläpito ja päivitykset - Käyttötuki suomeksi Pyydämme teitä vastaamaan seuraaviin kysymyksiin: Ratkaisun yleiskuvaus - Onko teillä tarjolla yllä kuvattuja toiminnallisuuksia sisältävä järjestelmäratkaisu? - Mikä on ratkaisunne nimi ja lyhyt kuvaus? - Mitkä ovat ratkaisunne keskeiset vahvuudet? Toiminnallisuudet - Miten ratkaisunne täyttää kuvatut toiminnallisuudet? Tekniset ominaisuudet - Millainen on ratkaisun tekninen arkkitehtuuri? - Miten tietoturva on varmistettu? - Mitä kielivaihtoehtoja järjestelmä tukee? Kokemukset ja referenssit - Onko hyvinvointialueilla/kunnissa ratkaisuanne käytössä? - Miten järjestelmän suoriutuu suuren organisaation palautevolyymista? - Voitteko toimittaa referenssitietoja järjestelmä asiakkaista? Lisätiedot - Mitä muita oleellisia ominaisuuksia ratkaisunne sisältää? - Miten järjestelmän käyttöönotto tyypillisesti toteutetaan? - Millaista tukea ja koulutusta tarjoatte? Hankintayksikkö varaa mahdollisuuden käydä Teams:lla järjestettäviä esittelytilaisuuksia tietopyyntöön/markkinavuoropuheluun vastanneiden kesken, mikäli hankintayksikkö katsoo sen tarpeelliseksi lisätietojen saamiseksi. Mahdollinen Teams-palaverin esittelyaika sisältää 30 minuuttia tarjottavan järjestelmän esittelyä ja 30 min keskustelua. Vastaukset kysymyksiin pyydetään lähettämään 30.9.2026 klo 15:00 mennessä. Vastaukset pyydetään lyhyesti ja informatiivisesti. Vastaukset pyydetään lähettämään osoitteeseen hankinnat@ekhva.fi.Viestin otsikko: Markkinakartoitus: Asiakaspalautejärjestelmä Tällä tietopyynnöllä/markkinakartoituksella ei pyydetä eikä tähän tietopyyntöön anneta tarjouksia, vaan tällä pyydetään VAIN hankintaan liittyviä tietoja. Markkinakartoitukseen/tietopyyntöön osallistuminen tai osallistumatta jättäminen ei vaikuta tarjoajan asemaan mahdollisessa tarjouskilpailussa. Markkinavuoropuhelukutsu ei sido vastaajaa (Toimittajaa) tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiseen, eikä tähän ilmoitukseen vastaaminen ole edellytyksenä myöhemmin varsinaiseen tarjouskilpailuun osallistumiselle. Markkinakartoitukseen osallistuvilla ei ole oikeutta saada korvausta osallistumisesta. Hankintayksikkö ei sitoudu toteuttamaan asianomaista hankintaa. Päätökset mahdollisen hankintaprosessin käynnistämisestä tehdään markkinakartoituksen jälkeen. Toimitettu materiaali käsitellään luottamuksellisena julkisuuslain 24 §:n 1 momentin 20 kohdan mukaan. Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialue kiittää etukäteen vastauksistanne. Ne ovat arvokkaita järjestelmätarpeidemme määrittelyssä ja mahdollisen hankinnan valmistelussa.

signals.description: Ziel des Vergabeverfahrens ist die Beauftragung eines leistungsfähigen Managed Service Providers (MSP), der die vollständige Planung, Steuerung, Umsetzung und betriebliche Überführung der Brownfield-Transformation der bestehenden SAP-ECC-Systemlandschaft auf SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition, im Rahmen von „RISE with SAP“ übernimmt. Gegenstand der Beauftragung ist eine ganzheitliche Transformations- und Betriebsleistung. Diese umfasst insbesondere die technische und fachliche Analyse der bestehenden Systemlandschaft, die SAP-S/4HANA-Conversion, die Überführung in die Private-Cloud-Umgebung, Testmigrationen und Datenkonvertierung, die Anpassung von Eigenentwicklungen, Add-ons und Schnittstellen sowie die Umsetzung und Optimierung der relevanten kaufmännischen Prozesse. Darüber hinaus sind SAP Fiori, Reporting und Embedded Analytics sowie die erforderlichen Integrationsleistungen, insbesondere unter Nutzung der SAP Business Technology Platform und der SAP Integration Suite, zu berücksichtigen. Der Auftragnehmer begleitet die Transformation einschließlich Tests, Cutover, Go-live, Hypercare, Schulungen und Übergabe in einen geregelten Betrieb und übernimmt anschließend die vereinbarten Managed Services sowie Betriebs-, Support- und Weiterentwicklungsleistungen. Dabei sind insbesondere der Clean-Core-Ansatz, die Aufrechterhaltung des laufenden Klinikbetriebs, die bestehenden Abhängigkeiten zu SAP IS-H, i.s.h.med, SAP HCM und weiteren Umsystemen sowie Anforderungen an Datenschutz, Informationssicherheit, Compliance, Verfügbarkeit, Skalierbarkeit und ein geordnetes Exit-Szenario zu berücksichtigen. Als vertragliche Grundlage ist der Abschluss eines EVB-IT Cloudvertrags vorgesehen, der sowohl die Transformations- und Einführungsleistungen bis zur Abnahme als auch die anschließend zu erbringenden Managed Services, Betriebs-, Support- und Weiterentwicklungsleistungen abbildet.

signals.description: Aufbau, Betrieb und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung eines integrierten VoC Feedback- und Analytics-Systems für die gesamte EUDI Wallet Support Organisation. Umfasst die Erhebung, Auswertung und Darstellung von B2C- und B2B-Feedback sowie operative Support-KPIs, Trendanalysen und automatisierter Mustererkennung. Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung ist die Vergabe von Leistungen für VoC / Feedback & Analytics der EUDI Wallet Support Organisation (EWSO). Der Auftragnehmer baut die VoC-Plattform auf, konfiguriert sämtliche Feedback-Instrumente (Post-Interaction-Surveys, IVR-CSAT, NPS, CES, B2B-Partner-Reviews, Agenten-Feedback-Loop) und richtet das operative KPI-Dashboard sowie das Musterwarnsystem (Pattern Alerting) ein. Der Auftragnehmer begleitet die Closed-Beta-Phase (Q4 2026) und die Go-live-Phase (Q1 2027) mit Hypercare-Support. Er übergibt nach geordnetem Wissenstransfer die operative Hoheit über das VoC-System und die Analytics-Plattform an das interne Team des Auftraggebers. Die Leistungen umfassen insbesondere die datenschutzkonforme Datenerhebung (DSGVO, EU-Hosting, Pseudonymisierung), die API-Integration mit dem Ticketsystem und der Telefonie-Infrastruktur (vgl. Ziff. 5. der Leistungsbeschreibung), die WCAG 2.1-konforme Gestaltung aller Feedback-Oberflächen sowie vollständige Systemdokumentation, Schulung des internen Teams und einen strukturierten Übergabeplan für die eigenständige Systemhoheit.

signals.description: Bereitstellung, Implementierung, Betrieb und Wartung der vollständigen technischen Infrastruktur für die EUDI Wallet Support Organisation. Umfasst alle Systeme vom Self-Service-Portal über das Ticketmanagement bis hin zu Telefonie, Knowledge Base und Identity Management. Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung ist die Vergabe von Leistungen für die Technische Infrastruktur der EUDI Wallet Support Organisation (EWSO), das sog. Tooling. Der Auftragnehmer implementiert, konfiguriert und nimmt in Betrieb: das Ticket- und CRM-System, die Knowledge Base und das FAQ-Portal, den In-App-Bot (oder die Kompatibilität zur Auftraggeber-internen App-Bot Lösung), die Telefonie- und IVR-Infrastruktur, die Anbindung und Kompatibilität zu dem B2B Portal: EUDI Hub, das IAM-System, das zentrale Event-Log-System und das Schwärzungssystem. Der Auftragnehmer begleitet die Closed-Beta-Phase (Q4 2026) und die Go-Live-Phase (Q1 2027) mit Hypercare-Support und übergibt nach geordnetem Wissenstransfer die operative Systemhoheit an das interne Team des Auftraggebers. Die Leistungen umfassen insbesondere die EU-konforme Infrastruktur ((ISO 27001), kein US-CLOUD-Act-Exposure), WCAG 21-Konformität aller Nutzer-Frontends, einen obligatorischen externen Penetrationstest vor Go-live sowie vollständige Systemdokumentation und Schulung des internen Teams.

signals.description: Vanguard Learning Trust invites qualified suppliers to tender for the provision of a cloud-based human resources information system (HRIS) and a fully managed payroll service to support approximately 615 employees across 6 schools and a central Trust team. The solution must deliver secure, efficient HR and payroll processes, ensure statutory compliance with UK employment, pensions and HMRC regulations, and provide high-quality support to both Trust leaders and school-based staff. Objectives The Trust aims to procure a combined HRIS and payroll solution that: Provides a single source of truth for employee data across all schools and the Trust's central team. Reduces administrative workloads and manual processing. Ensures accurate, timely payroll with all third-party submissions completed by the provider, including HMRC, pension providers, and statutory bodies. Supports workforce planning, reporting, and strategic oversight at Trust level. Offers excellent employee and manager self-service. Ensures data security, GDPR compliance, and UK-based hosting. Scope of software and services The software will include: General HR system of record (SoR) Absence and attendance management functionality, which will link to occupational sickness scheme requirements Time and expenses (the functionality for employees to log additional hours and expenses, which would only be approved at managerial level) Organisation structure Employee Self Service Manager Self Service People Analytics A fully managed payroll and pension service The Trust would not be procuring the functionality below in the first instance but may consider doing at a later date. These are, therefore, 'desirable' rather than 'essential': Integrated applicant tracking and onboarding functionality Performance management and appraisal functionality Case management functionality The service provision will include: Fully managed payroll services Fully managed pensions services Solution hosting Requirements Our requirements (functional and non-functional) have been listed and are provided in an Excel sheet along with this document. Supplier Responses Suppliers are requested to complete the supplier response columns within the requirements document and to provide a commercial proposal using the template in the attached sheet. Additionally, please provide a high level project plan to demonstrate the timescales that your solution could be deployed in and a copy of your customer support service-level agreement (SLA). signals.description: Αντικείμενο της σύμβασης είναι η αναβάθμιση και επέκταση του Πολυκαναλικού συστήματος ενημέρωσης και εξυπηρέτησης πολιτών 1555, το οποίο λειτουργεί από τη 1/10/2022, ως ενιαίος κόμβος εξυπηρέτησης πολιτών και επιχειρήσεων για θέματα αρμοδιότητας του Υπουργείου Εργασίας και Κοινωνικής Ασφάλισης και των εποπτευομένων φορέων του. Στο πλαίσιο της αναβάθμισης, ενισχύεται η ψηφιακή αρχιτεκτονική και τα λογισμικά υποσυστήματα, όπως η διαδικτυακή πύλη, η γνωσιακή βάση, λύσεις τεχνητής νοημοσύνης και το ticketing, ώστε το 1555 να μεταβεί σταδιακά από ένα κυρίως φωνοκεντρικό μοντέλο σε ένα ισορροπημένο μοντέλο εξυπηρέτησης, όπου οι πιο σύνθετες και ευαίσθητες υποθέσεις παραμένουν σε ανθρώπινη εξυπηρέτηση, με ενίσχυση εξειδικευμένων εκπροσώπων, ενώ, οι απλούστερες υποθέσεις κλείνουν μέσω self service υπηρεσιών και αυτοματισμών. Ειδικότερα, προβλέπεται αξιοποίηση λύσεων ΑΙ τόσο προς τον πολίτη, όσο και προς τον εκπρόσωπο, όπως IVR και ΑΙ agent για αναγνώριση προθέσεων και δρομολόγηση σε ψηφιακές λύσεις ή στους κατάλληλους εξειδικευμένους εκπροσώπους, εργαλεία agent assist που αντλούν περιεχόμενο από τη γνωσιακή βάση για μείωση λαθών και χρόνου χειρισμού, καθώς και analytics για κατανόηση αιτημάτων και καλύτερο σχεδιασμό στελέχωσης. Παράλληλα, ενισχύεται η διαλειτουργικότητα σε επίπεδο υποδομών ή και services με το Σύστημα Διαχείρισης Αιτημάτων Πολιτών (CC ticketing) και η αξιοποίηση δεδομένων από το ticketing και τη γνωσιακή βάση, με πρόβλεψη συνεχούς βελτίωσης μέσω ανατροφοδότησης και ανάλυσης συνομιλιών. Η λειτουργία των εξειδικευμένων συμβούλων θα επεκταθεί και θα ενισχυθεί, ώστε οι πολίτες να έχουν ακόμα μεγαλύτερη πρόσβαση σε προσωποποιημένη πληροφόρηση. Τα ψηφιακά συστήματα θα αναβαθμιστούν περαιτέρω και θα εισαχθούν και νέα, με στόχο την ενίσχυση της εξυπηρέτησης. Ομάδα εμπειρογνωμόνων θα μπορεί να πραγματοποιεί στοχευμένες μελέτες σε ειδική θεματολογία των εξυπηρετούμενων Φορέων, καθώς και θα μπορούν να πραγματοποιούνται έρευνες, ώστε να ενισχύονται περαιτέρω και οι Φορείς μέσα από το έργο. Η ανάπτυξη και η διαχείριση του έργου γίνεται σε πακέτα εργασίας ως ακολούθως : I. I. Δομή επικοινωνίας και εξυπηρέτησης κοινού II. Τεχνικές Υποδομές III. Έρευνες ικανοποίησης και Διασφάλιση ποιότητας IV. Ενίσχυση φορέων σε θεματολογία – ειδικές έρευνες V. Διαχείριση έργου VI. The Authority currently intends to conduct a two-stage Competitive Flexible Procedure under the Procurement Act 2023. signals.description: Background Innovate UK Business Connect brings together businesses, researchers, investors and partners to accelerate innovation across the UK. As part of UK Research and Innovation (UKRI), and a strategic delivery partner to Innovate UK, we connect organisations to funding opportunities, partnerships and expertise to help ideas move from concept to scale. One of the key tools for making these connections is events. We deliver a diverse portfolio of in-person, virtual and hybrid events, ranging from webinars and workshops to large-scale conferences and exhibitions. To support the effective planning, delivery and evaluation of these events, we are seeking proposals from suppliers who can provide a modern event management system that streamlines event operations, enhances the participant experience and supports data-driven decision-making. Description of work Innovate UK Business Connect is seeking tenders from providers who can supply a single event management system that supports the end-to-end event lifecycle, including event creation, registration management, attendee communications, speaker and exhibitor management, networking, reporting and post-event evaluation. The system should integrate with existing business systems where required and provide a single source of truth for event delivery teams. This aligns with the organisation's wider objective of ensuring events are outcome-led, measurable and supported by efficient registration, communication and reporting processes. The event management system should: • Deliver an intuitive and user-friendly delegate journey from registration through to post-event follow-up • Improve the event experience for speakers and exhibitors • Reduce manual administration and improve operational efficiency • Provide real-time visibility of registrations, attendance, engagement and event performance • Support both virtual and in-person event delivery models • Enable consistent data capture and reporting to demonstrate event impact and ROI • Support accessibility, compliance and data protection requirements The platform must support multiple user roles and permission levels to reflect different operational needs across the organisation. As a minimum, the system should accommodate the following user groups: • Event Managers o Full end-to-end event management capabilities o Creation, configuration and administration of events o Management of registrations, attendee communications, speakers and exhibitors o Access to event-level reporting, analytics and post-event evaluation data • Marketing Managers o Access to update and manage event webpages and associated content o Access to registration, engagement and performance reporting • Integrated Systems o Administration of integrations between the event management platform and our CRM system (Workbooks) o Management of data flows, field mapping, data quality and synchronisation processes o Access to reporting, data exports and system configuration relating to integrations • System Administrators o A small number of designated super users (typically two to three individuals) o Full platform administration rights, including user management, permissions, integrations, security settings and system configuration We deliver a large and diverse portfolio of business-to-business events. Historically, this has included more than 300 events per year and generating approximately 60,000 delegate registrations annually. The event management platform must be capable of supporting a range of event formats, scales and audience sizes, including: • In person events: We deliver approximately 100 in-person events each year, typically attracting between 30 and 2,000 delegates to each. Most events are free to attend and may span one or more days. We do not require onsite event delivery support from the appointment supplier; however the platform must provide the functionality and tools to enable our team to manage attendee registration and onsite event operations, and provide a seamless and efficient onsite experience for attendees • Online Events: We deliver close to 200 fully online events annually. The majority are webinars, including webinar series and interactive workshops. We also run a small number of larger-scale virtual conferences and exhibitions, some of which take place over multiple days. The platform should provide a seamless user experience for both organisers and attendees and support the delivery of events of varying size and complexity. • Hybrid: A smaller proportion of our events are hybrid, combining in-person and virtual attendance. The platform should support hybrid event delivery and provide a consistent registration, communication and reporting experience across both audience groups. The proposed solution must be capable of supporting this volume of activity while providing robust registration management, attendee communications, data integration, reporting and analytics across all event formats. Timings This is a two-stage evaluation process. We will do an initially score of each supplier bid with the top two or three scoring suppliers invited to provide a demonstration. This will be the opportunity for the selected suppliers to demonstrate the setup of an event using a given scenario. Anticipated timeline: • October: demo • November: final evaluation • November - December: Contract is awarded • 1 April 2027: Contract starts • April - September: Onboarding, training, templates created and integrations built • September onwards: Events start to be managed from the platform Cost The maximum value of this requirement over the three-year period is a maximum of £600,000.00 excluding VAT. This contract is structured as an initial two-year period with a maximum budget of £400,000.00 excluding VAT with an optional 12-month extension valued at maximum £200,000.00 excluding VAT. Submission In response to this tender, please provide the information listed below. • Short narrative describing your overall approach to working with Innovate UK Business Connect • Checklist against the requirements • Supporting information against the essential requirements • A rate card of costs associated with services you provide • A completed copy of the Pre-Qualification Questionnaire including: o A copy of your audited accounts for the most recent two years (or alternative means of demonstrating financial status if trading for less than a year) • Legal information i.e. Your standard T&Cs Please provide the information requested above to re.support@iukbc.org.uk by 17:00 10 October 2026 at the latest. IR35 will be assessed before the awarding of a successful contract. Submissions sent without relevant documents as listed above will be automatically rejected. Innovate UK Business Connect may require successful submissions to be subject to non-disclosure agreements. Evaluation structure Submissions will be scored against the following areas: • Value for money - 20% • Technical specification - 70% o alignment to objective 10% o essential requirements 40% o desirable requirements 20% • Demonstration - 10% Lot 1: .

signals.description: Technische Erneuerung und digitale Erweiterung des Parksystems für Smart Parking Lot LOT-0000: Stadtgebiet Bad Homburg v. d. Höhe, Smart Parking - Parksystem für Smart Parking. Gegenstand ist die technische Erneuerung und digitale Erweiterung der bestehenden Parkierungssysteme an 5 Standorten der Kur- und Kongreß-GmbH Bad Homburg v. d. Höhe sowie die Kompletterneuerung des Parkierungssystems im Karstadt-Parkhaus. Ziel ist eine moderne, serviceorientierte und funktional einheitliche Parkinfrastruktur. Die bestehenden Anlagen sollen so ergänzt werden, dass moderne digitale Parkprozesse auf Basis von Kennzeichenerkennung, QR-Code-Funktionen, bargeldloser Webzahlung, digitaler Rabattierung sowie Self-Service-Funktionen für Kurzzeit- und Dauerparker durchgängig und standortübergreifend genutzt werden können. Es soll kein isolierter Austausch einzelner Geräte erfolgen, sondern die funktionsfähige Erweiterung eines bereits vorhandenen Gesamtsystems. Leistungsbestandteile: Lieferung, Montage, Integration, Inbetriebnahme und Abnahme der Komponenten an allen Standorten; Bereitstellung und Einrichtung der zentralen Software- und Leitrechnerkomponenten. Technische Anforderungen und Integration: - Alle Komponenten müssen über die bestehende Leitrechner-/ Zellenrechner-Topologie zentral verwaltbar sein. - Ein durchgängiger Parkvorgang (Einfahrt - Identifikation über Ticket, Kennzeichen oder QR-Code - Bezahlung an Automaten/Webdienst/Rabattstelle - Ausfahrt - revisionssichere Abrechnung) muss systemübergreifend gewährleistet sein. - Schnittstellen, Firmware-/Backend-Stände und Datenmodelle sind herstellerseitig abgestimmt bereitzustellen. Montage, Inbetriebnahme und Abnahme: - Montage und Inbetriebnahme im laufenden Betrieb unter Minimierung von Ausfallzeiten; Koordination mit dem Projektsteuerer. - Abnahmekriterien und Teilabnahmen: Teilabnahme je Standort nach erfolgreichem Funktions-/Integrationstest; förmliche Gesamtabnahme nach vollständiger Systemintegration. Sonstige Leistungen: - Vollständige technische Dokumentation in deutscher Sprache. - Einweisung / Schulung des Personals: Einweisung des Betriebspersonals je Standort sowie Administrator-Schulung für das Leitrechnersystem. Für die Wartung der Anlagen ist ein Wartungsvertrag zu schließen, welcher folgende Bereiche abdeckt: Software, Leit-/Zellenrechner, Verfügbarkeit eines 24/7 erreichbaren technischen Servicecenter, Bereitschaftsdienst für Vor-Ort Wartung & Reparatur.

signals.description: Nordværk I/S udbyder anskaffelse, implementering og efterfølgende drift og vedligeholdelse af et nyt fagsystem til administration og understøttelse af affaldsindsamlingen, herefter benævnt Løsningen. Anskaffelsen gennemføres med henblik på at erstatte den nuværende systemunderstøttelse af Nordværks renovationsområde og etablere en samlet, tidssvarende og fremtidssikret Løsning, der kan understøtte de forretningsprocesser, som knytter sig til administration, planlægning, sagsbehandling, udførelse, registrering, opfølgning og dokumentation af affaldsindsamlingen. Anskaffelsen omfatter levering og implementering af Løsningen samt de ydelser, der er nødvendige for at etablere og tage Løsningen i brug. Dette omfatter blandt andet afklaring og konfiguration, migrering og etablering af relevante data, etablering og tilpasning af Integrationer, test, uddannelse, dokumentation, idriftsættelse samt efterfølgende drift, support, vedligeholdelse og videreudvikling i overensstemmelse med Kontrakten og Kontraktens bilag. Løsningen skal understøtte Nordværks samlede værdikæde på renovationsområdet fra en borgers eller kundes ordning, henvendelse eller bestilling til planlægning og udførelse af den konkrete renovationsopgave samt efterfølgende registrering, sagsbehandling, opfølgning, controlling, dokumentation og grundlag for afregning. Anskaffelsen indgår i Nordværks arbejde med at sikre en effektiv, sammenhængende og datadrevet administration og drift af affaldsindsamlingen. Løsningen skal understøtte standardiserede og kontrollerbare arbejdsgange, høj datakvalitet, reduceret behov for manuelle processer samt bedre muligheder for styring, opfølgning og løbende udvikling af renovationsområdet. Løsningen skal samtidig kunne indgå hensigtsmæssigt i Nordværks øvrige systemlandskab og understøtte organisatoriske, driftsmæssige og teknologiske ændringer over Kontraktens løbetid. Løsningens overordnede formål er navnlig: i) at understøtte sammenhængende og effektive arbejdsgange inden for kundeadministration, sagsbehandling, driftsplanlægning, opgaveudførelse, registrering, controlling og opfølgning, ii) at understøtte den operationelle affaldsindsamling for både Nordværks egne og eksterne renovatører, herunder planlægning, ruter, Navigation, registrering af udførte opgaver, håndtering af afvigelser og driftsmæssig opfølgning, og iii) at etablere et fleksibelt og fremtidssikret systemgrundlag med høj datakvalitet og gode muligheder for integration, konfiguration, automatisering, rapportering og løbende videreudvikling. De forretningsprocesser og den funktionalitet, der er gældende for Løsningen, er nærmere beskrevet i udbudsmaterialets Bilag 3 – Leverancebeskrivelse. Løsningen forventes at skulle understøtte flere forskellige interne og eksterne brugergrupper. Dette omfatter blandt andet ca. 186-200 interne renovationsmedarbejdere, 55-65 administrative medarbejdere, 10-20 administratorer/superbrugere, 40-50 administrative brugere hos eksterne renovatører samt 100-110 renovationsmedarbejdere hos eksterne renovatører. Brugergrupperne vil have forskellige roller og adgangsbehov i Løsningen. Løsningen skal etableres på en teknisk platform, der understøtter de krav til tilgængelighed, sikkerhed, integration, skalerbarhed, drift og videreudvikling, der fremgår af Kontrakten og Kontraktens bilag. De nærmere tekniske krav til Løsningen og dens etablering fremgår af udbudsmaterialets relevante bilag. Løsningen skal have en åben, gennemsigtig og veldokumenteret arkitektur og skal kunne indgå i Nordværks samlede systemlandskab. Leverandøren skal levere og vedligeholde den Dokumentation, der er nødvendig for blandt andet drift, administration, Integrationer, konfiguration, fejlsøgning og videreudvikling af Løsningen, i overensstemmelse med kravene i Kontrakten og Kontraktens bilag. Løsningen understøtter forretningskritiske processer i forbindelse med den daglige administration og udførelse af affaldsindsamlingen. Der stilles derfor krav til blandt andet Løsningens tilgængelighed, stabilitet, sikkerhed, sporbarhed og dataintegritet, således at data og registreringer kan anvendes pålideligt i den operationelle drift, kundebetjening, sagsbehandling, controlling, dokumentation og som grundlag for afregning. Løsningen skal integreres med en række af Nordværks øvrige systemer og tekniske løsninger. Dette omfatter blandt andet relevante snitflader til afregningssystem, GIS- og datagrundlag, selvbetjeningsløsninger, registreringsudstyr, vejesystemer og øvrige tredjepartsløsninger, hvor dataudveksling er nødvendig for at understøtte sammenhængende arbejdsgange. De konkrete krav til Integrationer og snitflader fremgår af udbudsmaterialets relevante bilag. Udbuddet indeholder endvidere en række optioner på yderligere funktionalitet og leverancer, som Nordværk kan vælge at gøre brug af i overensstemmelse med Kontrakten. De konkrete optioner og vilkårene herfor fremgår af Kontrakten og Kontraktens bilag, herunder Bilag 3 – Leverancebeskrivelse. Ibrugtagning af Løsningen skal ske efter gennemførelse af de aftalte aktiviteter vedrørende blandt andet afklaring, konfiguration, datamigrering, Integrationer, test, uddannelse og godkendelse. Den nærmere fremgangsmåde og tidsplan for implementering og Ibrugtagning fastlægges i overensstemmelse med Kontrakten og de relevante bilag. Kontrakten indeholder således en implementeringsperiode på op til 12 måneder samt efter Ibrugtagning en driftsperiode på 6 år med mulighed for forlængelse på 2 gange 12 måneder. Den nærmere fremgangsmåde og tidsplan for implementering og Ibrugtagning fastlægges i overensstemmelse med Kontrakten og de relevante bilag. Kontrakten indeholder således en implementeringsperiode på op til 12 måneder samt efter Ibrugtagning en driftsperiode på 6 år med mulighed for forlængelse på 2 gange 12 måneder. Renovationssystemet, som nævnt under punkt 3, er udbudt særskilt. Renovationssystemet opdeles ikke i delaftaler af økonomiske og markedsmæssige hensyn, herunder at det vil være uhensigtsmæssigt for Nordværk med flere udviklingsleverandører.

signals.description: Fairhive Homes Limited intends to procure a contract for the supply, implementation, configuration, support, maintenance and continuous improvement of a Learning Management System. The procurement is intended to support Fairhive's requirement for an LMS platform that enables effective learning management, compliance training, reporting, user administration and integration with Fairhive's wider systems environment. The RFQ states that Fairhive wishes to appoint a single supplier to provide, implement, configure, support and maintain the LMS in accordance with the specification. The requirement is expected to include: 1. Supply of a hosted Learning Management System platform. 2. Configuration of workflows, roles, permissions, learning pathways, dashboards, notifications and branding. 3. Implementation support, including mobilisation, discovery, implementation planning, testing, user acceptance testing, go-live support and hypercare. 4. Data migration support, including extraction support, mapping, cleansing support, migration, reconciliation and validation. 5. Microsoft Entra ID Single Sign-On and user provisioning integration. 6. Microsoft 365 integrations, including Microsoft Teams and Outlook calendar integration. 7. Administrator, manager and end-user training, including materials and train-the-trainer or digital resources. 8. Initial content and SCORM set-up, including upload, configuration and validation of SCORM 1.2/2004 and other agreed content. 9. Ongoing hosting, storage, backups, disaster recovery, support, service levels, maintenance, updates, escalation and account management. 10. Reporting, dashboards and scheduled reporting. Suppliers will be expected to demonstrate: 1. Relevant experience implementing and supporting Learning Management Systems for a housing association, public sector organisation or similarly regulated environment. 2. A functional solution that supports learning pathways, compliance training management, reporting and dashboards, certification, SCORM compliance, accessibility, mobile functionality, workflow automation, manager functionality, learner experience and Microsoft 365 integration. 3. A clear implementation, data migration and training methodology, including project mobilisation, configuration, testing, user acceptance testing, data migration, training, go-live support and hypercare. 4. Robust information security, compliance and business continuity arrangements, including ISO27001, Cyber Essentials Plus, UK GDPR compliance, data hosting, resilience, disaster recovery, business continuity and incident management. 5. Effective support, service desk, account management, service level, escalation, reporting, quarterly review, product roadmap and continuous improvement arrangements. 6. Measurable social value and sustainability commitments, including community investment, skills and employment support, carbon reduction, digital inclusion, volunteering, equality, diversity and inclusion, supplier diversity and wider environmental sustainability initiatives. Fairhive intends to use the procurement documentation and evaluation process to assess the optimum combination of quality, social value and price. The RFQ defines Most Advantageous Tender as the tender offering the optimum combination of quality, social value and price in accordance with the evaluation methodology. Particular emphasis is expected to be placed on: 1. Functional LMS capability and user experience. 2. Compliance training management and reporting. 3. Data security, UK GDPR compliance and hosting arrangements. 4. Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID integration. 5. Implementation, data migration and training support. 6. Service desk, support, service levels and account management. 7. Social value, sustainability and measurable community benefits. Lot 1: .

signals.description: NHS Wales Shared Services Partnership (NWSSP), hosted by Velindre University NHS Trust, are issuing this Market Engagement Notice to engage with the suppliers to gather feedback on market capabilities and capacity for the provision of managed services to support the operation of a finance, procurement and warehouse management system. The Central Team eBusiness Services (CTeS), within NWSSP, manage and supervise several core national enterprise systems which are used by Health Boards, Trusts, Special Heath Authorities, and Hosted Organisations, in Wales. These systems are collectively known as the FMS Enterprise System and include: - An e-Business Application System, including auxiliary services, which is facilitated through the Oracle eBusiness suite. - A Business Intelligence (BI) reporting system, facilitated through Qlik Sense. - An OCR Intelligent Scanning Management System - A Warehouse Management System - Other BI Reporting Systems The purpose of this market engagement exercise is to gather greater insight into the market’s capacity and capabilities in relation to provision of managed services and NWSSP are specifically seeking engagement from suppliers who are e-Business Suite experts with supply chain capabilities specifically covering warehouse management and who can also support to roll out and further development of discrete manufacturing processes within a regulated environment. The analysis of feedback obtained from this exercise will allow NWSSP to further develop its strategy and refine its service delivery requirements ahead of any potential procurement. The main objectives of this exercise are to: - Assess the level of interest in the marketplace from suppliers who can support the Oracle eBusiness Suite (EBS), - Test market capability and capacity, - Validate the proposed scope and service model, - Understand delivery approaches, innovations and commercial models and indicative rates, and - Explore development and innovation in relation to AI and the benefits that may be realised with its deployment through the Oracle eBusiness Suite. The provision of the Oracle EBS is facilitated through existing perpetual licences, and the scope of this engagement exercise does not include migrating the e-Business Application System to a Software as a Service (SaaS) model. This exercise is not a formal procurement process, does not constitute a call for competition and does not commit NHS Wales to any future procurement. However, information gathered through this engagement will help inform the development, scope and future direction of the project. Suppliers can express their interest in this process and request a copy of the Market Engagement Briefing Document, which contains further details on the requirement and engagement process, by contacting Chris Squires (christopher.squires@wales.nhs.uk). When submitting an expression of interest, suppliers are requested to confirm that they acknowledge and understand that: - the proposed managed service requirement relates specifically to Oracle E-Business Suite (Oracle EBS) and does not include support for Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions; - they have the necessary supply chain capabilities to support the requirements of the service; and - they possess the capability and expertise to support the development of warehouse management systems within discrete manufacturing environments. Suppliers will have the opportunity to participate in a structured engagement session which are scheduled for the 5th, 8th and 14th October. There are 10 sessions available and these will be allocated on a first come first served basis. However, NWSSP reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to make additional sessions available should there be sufficient interest from the market. No guarantee is given that additional sessions will be offered. Lot 1: . None

signals.description: Further to the UK1 Pipeline Notice published on 19th November 2025 by BlueLight Commercial Limited (ref: 2025/S 000-077692) in relation to a Victim & Citizen Engagement Technology Solution which will be used by UK law enforcement agencies, this UK2 Preliminary Market Engagement Notice is issued to inform the market of a potential future opportunity. This Pre-Market Engagement Notice is issued solely for the purposes of information gathering and engagement with the market. It does not constitute a call for competition and create any obligation on the Authority to proceed with a procurement exercise, or enter into any commercial arrangement. Please note the procurement route and anticipated publication date for this opportunity are yet to be determined. These elements will be confirmed following completion of the market engagement process and development of the Authority’s commercial strategy. Any future procurement will be subject to separate formal notice and the publication of full procurement documentation via the Find a Tender Service (FTS). BlueLight Commercial Limited (BLC) are conducting Preliminary Market Engagement to gain a better understanding of the market, supplier appetite, capacity, and capability, as well as perceived risks and opportunities. Any learnings will be used to formulate the associated procurement strategy. BLC work in collaboration with blue light organisations to maximise commercial benefit to UK emergency services. The focus of this solution will be improving Victim & Citizen Engagement, building trust and confidence, reducing demand within control rooms, and reducing the costs of serving the public by using innovative software to keep both victims and citizens more engaged. The aim is to ensure all forces have access to the most effective, reliable, and innovative solutions available in the market. This Solution needs to facilitate the force contact engagement from first contact with a police force to final closure of the contact, and via integration with police systems, e.g. Command and Control, Records Management Systems providing contact and updates throughout the journey without the need to call the force contact centre. It seeks to further drive standardisation and consistency, whilst helping forces to develop capability and invest in technology which will not only improve the service at first point of contact but will improve the overall contact experience. This Solution must facilitate Victim & Citizen engagement to reduce failure demand whilst proactively engaging to ensure high levels of customer (internal and external) trust and confidence. The delivery of the desired solution may be considered to follow the same customer service path as an online application or ordering process. For example, acknowledgement of the initial contact, time appropriate follow up contacts at defined points within the communication journey, and a closure contact at the end of the process. All communication will be auditable and align with the Victims code as appropriate. We are looking for solutions that can meet individual force needs and achieve the following: *Improve experience of members of the public accessing the policing service *Provide the public with consistent updates in a timely manner, *Improve public trust, confidence, and satisfaction, *Reduce Contact Management demand, *Improve force's overall Contact Management performance. signals.description: HESA (part of Jisc) are seeking a supplier to support the annual coding of occupational information. Following its merger with the Higher Education Statistics Agency, Jisc has retained 'HESA' as a brand name, and Jisc's functions, activities and role as the DDB are undertaken by a dedicated directorate within Jisc, operating under the HESA brand. References to HESA within the Specification do not mean any legal entity. This will include Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) and Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) codes from the Office for National Statistics (ONS), along with some additional information to supplement this. The supply of this data will support our role as the designated data body for the HE sector, ensuring high quality, consistent classification of employer data. As survey responses are received, HESA/Jisc will securely make available to the supplier, in batches, an overnight file of the employer, course and role information to enable the supplier to complete the required SIC and SOC coding and return it to HESA/Jisc using an encrypted secure bulk data sending system. In addition to the purposes set out below, the coding will be used by Jisc to update and feed into the Graduate Outcomes provider dashboards so that Providers have visibility of the progress and outcomes of the coding. HESA/Jisc will run the Graduate Outcomes survey, working with third-party suppliers to manage the call centre system for contact management and to provide an online survey. It will be necessary for the supplier to join review calls with HESA/Jisc and HESA/Jisc's third-party suppliers to feedback any improvements required to the job role and employer data to improve the accuracy of coding. signals.description: The Student Loans company (SLC) have an agreement for Enhanced Security Operations Managed Service expiring April 2028. In order to provision for a retender of the agreement SLC are undertaking pre-market engagement with regards to the provision of the following: • Requirement A: Enhanced Security Operations Managed Service - MXDR Service (2026-TR-0109a) • Requirement B: Enhanced Security Operations Managed Service - Vulnerability Management (VM) Service (2026-TR-0109b) • Requirement C: Enhanced Security Operations Managed Service - Breach Attack Simulation (BAS) Service (2026-TR-0109c) • Requirement D: Enhanced Security Operations Managed Service - Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) Service (2026-TR-0109d) • Requirement E: Enhanced Security Operations Managed Service - Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR) Retainer Service (2026-TR-0109e) • Requirement F: Enhanced Security Operations Managed Service - Security Architecture and Engineering Support Services (2026-TR-0109f) SLC is considering an approach to the market to give the suppliers an option to bid for one or ALL of the contractual requirements. Requirement A Enhanced Security Operations Managed Service - MXDR Service The Supplier will provide a Managed Extended Detection and Response (MXDR) capability operating on a hybrid customer/supplier model. MXDR Service The Supplier will provide: • 24x7x365 monitoring of SLC security telemetry. • L1 and L2 Security Operations Centre capability (SLC retain L3). • Incident identification, triage and investigation. • Security use-case monitoring and tuning. • Management of Microsoft Sentinel detections. • SOAR playbook execution and optimisation. • Escalation management. • Alert enrichment. • Threat hunting capability. • Malicious activity investigation. • Service governance and performance management. • Security reporting at operational, tactical and strategic levels. Security Engineering (Operational) The Supplier shall provide: • L3 Engineering support for Sentinel. • Analytics rule development and tuning. • SOAR playbook management. • Connector maintenance and health monitoring. • Logging optimisation. • Onboarding and validation of agreed log sources. • Detection engineering support. • Detection gap analysis and monitoring coverage reviews. • Security use case development and continuous improvement. • Monitoring health checks. • Monitoring and remediation of ingestion issues. • Security platform optimisation. • Proactive automation support and development. • Threat intelligence-led detection improvements. Data Loss Prevention (DLP) & Phishing The Supplier shall: • Monitoring, triage and investigation of DLP, phishing, business email compromise (BEC), malicious email, malicious attachment and malicious URL alerts. • Investigation of suspected data loss, data exfiltration and policy breach events. • Support for user reported phishing submissions. • Escalation and coordination of confirmed incidents in accordance with agreed response procedures. • Identification and analysis of phishing campaigns, attacker infrastructure, indicators of compromise and emerging attack trends. • Recommendations for improvements to DLP policies, email security controls, detections and response processes. • Monthly reporting, trend analysis and security improvement recommendations. Reporting The Supplier shall provide: • Weekly operational reports. • Monthly service reports. • Quarterly service reviews. • KPI and SLA reporting. • Security metrics and trend analysis. Requirement B Enhanced Security Operations Managed Service - Vulnerability Management Service The Supplier shall provide Vulnerability Management services Monday to Friday, UK Core Hours (09:00-17:00). Vulnerability Management The Supplier shall: • Monitor vulnerability management queues. • Investigate vulnerability notifications. • Manage vulnerability triage. • Validate vulnerability findings. • Perform exploitability assessments. • Provide remediation recommendations. • Support exposure management activities. • Support CTEM activities. Stakeholder Engagement The Supplier shall: • Conduct monthly technical review meetings. • Support resolver teams. • Assist remediation planning. • Review remediation performance. • Provide vulnerability prioritisation guidance. Dashboarding & Reporting The Supplier shall: • Maintain executive dashboards. • Enhance Power BI reporting. • Produce technical reports. • Produce executive reports. • Produce PCI compliance reports. • Produce risk trending reports. Tooling The Supplier shall support: • Microsoft Defender for Endpoint. • Rapid7. • SLC PCI ASV Scanning tooling. • Jira. • Power BI. Requirement C Enhanced Security Operations Managed Service - Breach Attack Simulation Service The Supplier shall provide a Breach Attack Simulation (BAS) capability, currently using AttackIQ or similar. BAS Service The Supplier shall: • Operate and maintain the BAS platform. • Deploy and maintain BAS agents. • Configure integrations. • Execute scheduled simulations. • Execute customer-specific simulations. • Execute retests following remediation activities. Adversary Simulation Testing scenarios shall include: • Initial Access. • Execution. • Persistence. • Privilege Escalation. • Credential Access. • Lateral Movement. • Command and Control. • Exfiltration. • Malware. • Ransomware. • Advanced Persistent Threat activity. Security Validation The Supplier shall assess: • Security control effectiveness. • Security monitoring effectiveness. • Detection coverage. • Response capability. • Incident handling. • Use-case effectiveness. Reporting The Supplier shall produce: • Monthly BAS reports. • Executive summaries. • Technical findings. • Remediation recommendations. • Retest outcomes. Requirement D Enhanced Security Operations Managed Service - Cyber Threat Intelligence Service The Supplier shall provide strategic, operational and tactical Cyber Threat Intelligence services. Threat Intelligence Managed Service The Supplier shall provide: • Threat Intelligence reporting. • Integration into Microsoft Sentinel. • Indicator of Compromise feeds. • Threat actor intelligence. Operational Intelligence The Supplier shall provide: • Threat alerts. • Vulnerability intelligence. • Emerging threat notifications. • Campaign tracking. • Industry specific intelligence. Strategic Intelligence The Supplier shall provide: • Threat landscape assessments. • Quarterly threat reports. • Executive intelligence briefings. • Board level threat summaries. • Sector specific threat reporting. Security Operations Support The Supplier shall provide: • Intelligence support during incidents. • Threat hunting support. • Intelligence driven use-case creation. • Intelligence enrichment services. Requirement E Enhanced Security Operations Managed Service - Digital Forensics & Incident Response Retainer Service The Supplier shall provide a DFIR Retainer available 24x7x365. Cyber Incident Response The Supplier shall provide: • Incident investigation. • Malware analysis. • Threat containment. • Threat eradication. • Recovery support. • Crisis management support. • Regulator support. • On-site support Digital Forensics The Supplier shall provide: • Evidence acquisition. • Chain of custody management. • Endpoint forensics. • Server forensics. • Network forensics. • Cloud forensics. • Forensic reporting. Readiness Services The Supplier shall provide access to: • Tabletop exercises. • Incident simulations. • Executive workshops. • CSIRT training. • Lessons learned reviews. Retained Consultancy The Supplier shall provide specialist support including: • Security strategy input. • Audit support. • Major incident reviews. • Regulatory engagement support. • Ransomware negotiation services. Requirement F Enhanced Security Operations Managed Service - Security Architecture & Engineering Support Services The Supplier shall provide specialist Security Architecture and Engineering services on a call-off basis. Security Architecture The Supplier shall provide: • Security architecture reviews. • Security design authority support. • Secure by Design reviews. • Solution security reviews. • Threat modelling. • Architecture governance. • Security requirements definition. • Architectural risk assessments. Security Engineering The Supplier shall provide: • Technical security engineering. • Security tool implementation. • Security configuration reviews. • Security hardening activities. • Technical control implementation. Strategy & Transformation The Supplier shall provide: • Security roadmap development. • Target operating model development. • Control framework assessments. • Security maturity reviews. • Improvement planning. Governance & Assurance The Supplier shall provide: • Security assessments. • Risk management support. • Audit support. • KPI development. • Board reporting support. • Security governance support. • Independent design and control assurance. • Security exception and risk acceptance reviews. • Third party and supplier security assessments. signals.description: Smart Applications Management Limited (SAM) is the trading name of South West Smart Applications Limited, a Membership based central purchasing body, which owns and runs the National Mobilities Procurement Hub for its Members. The Goods and Services will be supplied via Award Without Competition and by Competitive Selection Process. Lot 1 of this Framework is seeking the provision of On Vehicle Digital Technology (AVL, CCTV, APC, TLP, Comms, On Bus Destination, AVA, Bridge Strike Systems & Vehicle Compute Capability). Lot 1 - has 9 parts: Lot 1 - Part 1 - Automated Vehicle Location (AVL) Solution Provision of an integrated Automated Vehicle Location solution capable of accurately determining and communicating vehicle location in real time. The solution shall support route, journey and stop association, estimated arrival/departure information and integration with other onboard and back-office systems. Requirements include resilient positioning, industry-standard data interfaces, remote configuration, monitoring, diagnostics, reporting, security and ongoing support throughout the solution lifecycle. Lot 1 - Part 2 - Closed Circuit Television (CCTV) Solution Provision of a comprehensive onboard CCTV solution providing appropriate internal and external vehicle coverage for passenger safety, operational management and incident investigation. The solution shall support continuous high-quality recording, secure storage and retrieval, authorised access and evidential integrity. Requirements include integration with other onboard systems, equipment health monitoring, remote diagnostics, secure communications, configurable camera arrangements and enhanced analytics where required. Lot 1 - Part 3 - Automatic Passenger Counting (APC) Solution Provision of an Automatic Passenger Counting solution capable of accurately recording passenger boarding and alighting and determining vehicle occupancy without driver intervention. The solution shall provide reliable passenger-count data for operational, planning and passenger-information purposes and integrate with onboard and central systems. Requirements include appropriate counting accuracy, standardised interfaces, secure data transfer, reporting, monitoring, diagnostics, remote management and resilient operation. Lot 1 - Part 4 - Traffic Light Priority (TLP) Solution Provision of a Traffic Light Priority solution enabling suitably equipped vehicles to request priority at traffic signals based on vehicle location, route and operational circumstances. The solution shall support configurable and conditional priority strategies and integration with vehicle, roadside and central systems. Requirements include secure, low-latency communications, monitoring and reporting, remote configuration, interoperability, performance analysis, testing, cybersecurity and ongoing technical support. Lot 1 - Part 5 - Comms Tool (Radio) Solution Provision of an onboard communications solution enabling reliable and secure voice and data communication between drivers, vehicles and operational control functions. The solution shall support operational messaging, service information, alerts and emergency communications through an appropriate driver interface. Requirements include integration with other onboard systems, secure communications, operational logging, remote configuration, equipment monitoring, diagnostics and resilient operation across the vehicle fleet. Lot 1 - Part 6 - On-Bus Destination Solution Provision of integrated on-bus destination equipment capable of clearly displaying route and destination information to passengers and intending passengers. Solutions shall support appropriate front, side and rear displays, accessibility and visibility requirements and integration with onboard systems to automate displayed information. Requirements include remote configuration, operational overrides, equipment monitoring, diagnostics, secure communications, robust vehicle-grade equipment and ongoing maintenance and support. Lot 1 - Part 7 - Audio Visual Passenger Information (AVA) Solution Provision of an accessible onboard Audio Visual Passenger Information solution delivering automated visual and audible information concerning routes, destinations, next stops, disruptions and other relevant passenger messages. The solution shall integrate with vehicle location and onboard systems to trigger information accurately. Requirements include accessible presentation, remote and priority messaging, configurable content, secure communications, monitoring, diagnostics, resilient operation and ongoing system support. Lot 1 - Part 8 - Bridge Strike Prevention Solution Provision of an onboard Bridge Strike Prevention solution designed to reduce the risk of vehicles approaching or striking structures with insufficient clearance. The solution shall use vehicle dimensions together with accurate location, mapping and detection information to provide timely audible and visual driver warnings. Requirements include reliable hazard identification, minimisation of false alerts, offline resilience, secure updates, event logging, diagnostics and onboard-system integration. Lot 1 - Part 9 - Vehicle Compute Capability (VCC) Solution Provision of a robust onboard Vehicle Compute Capability providing a shared computing platform for hosting, integrating and managing multiple vehicle applications and data services. The solution shall provide sufficient processing capacity, storage and future scalability while supporting secure application separation and interoperability. Requirements include edge processing, secure communications, remote software management, monitoring and diagnostics, onboard-system integration and future expansion throughout its operational lifecycle. Lot 2 is for Franchising and Wider Transport Ticketing & Payment Consultancy Services. It has 6 Parts: Lot 2 - Part 1 - Franchised Bus Scheme Development and Implementation Support The provision of specialist consultancy services to support the development, assessment and implementation of bus franchising schemes. Services may include business cases, network and commercial design, financial modelling, consultation, procurement, mobilisation, integrated fares and ticketing, assets and technology, contract management, service permits, independent assurance and stakeholder engagement. Lot 2 - Part 2 - Transport Ticketing Management Policy Advice The provision of strategic, policy and management consultancy relating to transport ticketing and payment systems. Services may encompass ITSO, Stored Value, contactless EMV, barcode and QR ticketing, Account Based and Multi-Token Ticketing, Mobility as a Service, and wider ticketing initiatives across public-sector authorities, transport operators and national organisations. Lot 2 - Part 3 - Transport Ticketing Technical & Revenue Scheme Delivery The provision of technical consultancy and delivery support for transport ticketing schemes, including development of technical specifications, implementation and integration of ITSO and other ticketing technologies, Electronic Ticket Machines and ticketing readers. Services may also include management of multi-platform implementations and development of technical solutions through engagement with relevant stakeholders. Lot 2 - Part 4 - Transport Ticketing Governance, Research and Competitive Bidding Services The provision of specialist support relating to transport ticketing governance, research, procurement and competitive funding or bidding activities. Services may include governance advice for public and commercial organisations, preparation of grant, tender and franchise submissions, support for public procurement exercises, and research activities contributing to sustainable transport policy and delivery. Lot 2 - Part 5 - Entitlement (Concessionary) Travel Management Services The provision of management, policy and project support for entitlement and concessionary travel schemes, with particular emphasis on revenue reimbursement and apportionment. Services may include multi-operator and multimodal schemes, multiple ITSO HOPS and Customer Management Systems, and schemes operating across multiple ticketing channels, technologies and participating organisations. Lot 2 - Part 6 - Technical Entitlement (Concessionary) Support Services The provision of specialist technical support for entitlement and concessionary travel schemes, including reimbursement implementation, revenue modelling and apportionment, ETM data analysis, national reimbursement guidance and alternative allocation methodologies. Services may also encompass auditable datasets, payment reporting, stakeholder-led revenue solutions and expert technical evidence supporting appeals, tribunals or legal proceedings. Lot 1.: On Vehicle Digital Technology (AVL, CCTV, APC, TLP, Comms, On Bus Destination, AVA, Bridge Strike Systems & Vehicle Compute Capability). Lot 1 - On Vehicle Digital Technology (AVL, CCTV, APC, TLP, Comms, On Bus Destination, AVA, Bridge Strike Systems & Vehicle Compute Capability). Lot 1 comprises nine on-vehicle technology Parts, with the detailed Requirements Specification forming the basis from which deliverables may be identified at individual call-off. The 9 Parts are: Lot 1 - Part 1 - Automated Vehicle Location (AVL) Solution Provision of an integrated Automated Vehicle Location solution capable of accurately determining and communicating vehicle location in real time. The solution shall support route, journey and stop association, estimated arrival/departure information and integration with other onboard and back-office systems. Requirements include resilient positioning, industry-standard data interfaces, remote configuration, monitoring, diagnostics, reporting, security and ongoing support throughout the solution lifecycle. Lot 1 - Part 2 - Closed Circuit Television (CCTV) Solution Provision of a comprehensive onboard CCTV solution providing appropriate internal and external vehicle coverage for passenger safety, operational management and incident investigation. The solution shall support continuous high-quality recording, secure storage and retrieval, authorised access and evidential integrity. Requirements include integration with other onboard systems, equipment health monitoring, remote diagnostics, secure communications, configurable camera arrangements and enhanced analytics where required. Lot 1 - Part 3 - Automatic Passenger Counting (APC) Solution Provision of an Automatic Passenger Counting solution capable of accurately recording passenger boarding and alighting and determining vehicle occupancy without driver intervention. The solution shall provide reliable passenger-count data for operational, planning and passenger-information purposes and integrate with onboard and central systems. Requirements include appropriate counting accuracy, standardised interfaces, secure data transfer, reporting, monitoring, diagnostics, remote management and resilient operation. Lot 1 - Part 4 - Traffic Light Priority (TLP) Solution Provision of a Traffic Light Priority solution enabling suitably equipped vehicles to request priority at traffic signals based on vehicle location, route and operational circumstances. The solution shall support configurable and conditional priority strategies and integration with vehicle, roadside and central systems. Requirements include secure, low-latency communications, monitoring and reporting, remote configuration, interoperability, performance analysis, testing, cybersecurity and ongoing technical support. Lot 1 - Part 5 - Comms Tool (Radio) Solution Provision of an onboard communications solution enabling reliable and secure voice and data communication between drivers, vehicles and operational control functions. The solution shall support operational messaging, service information, alerts and emergency communications through an appropriate driver interface. Requirements include integration with other onboard systems, secure communications, operational logging, remote configuration, equipment monitoring, diagnostics and resilient operation across the vehicle fleet. Lot 1 - Part 6 - On-Bus Destination Solution Provision of integrated on-bus destination equipment capable of clearly displaying route and destination information to passengers and intending passengers. Solutions shall support appropriate front, side and rear displays, accessibility and visibility requirements and integration with onboard systems to automate displayed information. Requirements include remote configuration, operational overrides, equipment monitoring, diagnostics, secure communications, robust vehicle-grade equipment and ongoing maintenance and support. Lot 1 - Part 7 - Audio Visual Passenger Information (AVA) Solution Provision of an accessible onboard Audio Visual Passenger Information solution delivering automated visual and audible information concerning routes, destinations, next stops, disruptions and other relevant passenger messages. The solution shall integrate with vehicle location and onboard systems to trigger information accurately. Requirements include accessible presentation, remote and priority messaging, configurable content, secure communications, monitoring, diagnostics, resilient operation and ongoing system support. Lot 1 - Part 8 - Bridge Strike Prevention Solution Provision of an onboard Bridge Strike Prevention solution designed to reduce the risk of vehicles approaching or striking structures with insufficient clearance. The solution shall use vehicle dimensions together with accurate location, mapping and detection information to provide timely audible and visual driver warnings. Requirements include reliable hazard identification, minimisation of false alerts, offline resilience, secure updates, event logging, diagnostics and onboard-system integration. Lot 1 - Part 9 - Vehicle Compute Capability (VCC) Solution Provision of a robust onboard Vehicle Compute Capability providing a shared computing platform for hosting, integrating and managing multiple vehicle applications and data services. The solution shall provide sufficient processing capacity, storage and future scalability while supporting secure application separation and interoperability. Requirements include edge processing, secure communications, remote software management, monitoring and diagnostics, onboard-system integration and future expansion throughout its operational lifecycle. Lot 1 Goods and Services will be supplied via Award Without Competition and by Competitive Selection Process. Lot 2: Franchising and Wider Transport Ticketing & Payment Consultancy Services. Lot 2 is for Franchising and Wider Transport Ticketing & Payment Consultancy Services. It has 6 Parts: Lot 2 - Part 1 - Franchised Bus Scheme Development and Implementation Support The provision of specialist consultancy services to support the development, assessment and implementation of bus franchising schemes. Services may include business cases, network and commercial design, financial modelling, consultation, procurement, mobilisation, integrated fares and ticketing, assets and technology, contract management, service permits, independent assurance and stakeholder engagement. Lot 2 - Part 2 - Transport Ticketing Management Policy Advice The provision of strategic, policy and management consultancy relating to transport ticketing and payment systems. Services may encompass ITSO, Stored Value, contactless EMV, barcode and QR ticketing, Account Based and Multi-Token Ticketing, Mobility as a Service, and wider ticketing initiatives across public-sector authorities, transport operators and national organisations. Lot 2 - Part 3 - Transport Ticketing Technical & Revenue Scheme Delivery The provision of technical consultancy and delivery support for transport ticketing schemes, including development of technical specifications, implementation and integration of ITSO and other ticketing technologies, Electronic Ticket Machines and ticketing readers. Services may also include management of multi-platform implementations and development of technical solutions through engagement with relevant stakeholders. Lot 2 - Part 4 - Transport Ticketing Governance, Research and Competitive Bidding Services The provision of specialist support relating to transport ticketing governance, research, procurement and competitive funding or bidding activities. Services may include governance advice for public and commercial organisations, preparation of grant, tender and franchise submissions, support for public procurement exercises, and research activities contributing to sustainable transport policy and delivery. Lot 2 - Part 5 - Entitlement (Concessionary) Travel Management Services The provision of management, policy and project support for entitlement and concessionary travel schemes, with particular emphasis on revenue reimbursement and apportionment. Services may include multi-operator and multimodal schemes, multiple ITSO HOPS and Customer Management Systems, and schemes operating across multiple ticketing channels, technologies and participating organisations. Lot 2 - Part 6 - Technical Entitlement (Concessionary) Support Services The provision of specialist technical support for entitlement and concessionary travel schemes, including reimbursement implementation, revenue modelling and apportionment, ETM data analysis, national reimbursement guidance and alternative allocation methodologies. Services may also encompass auditable datasets, payment reporting, stakeholder-led revenue solutions and expert technical evidence supporting appeals, tribunals or legal proceedings. Lot 2 Goods and Services will be supplied via Award Without Competition and by Competitive Selection Process.

signals.description: Rahmenvereinbarung iBS II Lot LOT-0001: Integriertes Bediensystem (iBS). Das integrierte Bediensystem (iBS) ist ein Teilsystem des integrierten Leit- und Bediensystems (iLBS) und beinhaltet u.a. die zentralen Dienste des iBS (iBS-Z), gemäß der Redundanzregelung 2 integrierte Bedienplätze (iBP), die Referenzbildfunktion (RBF), die iBS-Kommunikation (iBS-Kom) sowie die iBS-ZKonsole. Das Teilsystem iBS ist über standardisierte Schnittstellen mit anderen Teilsystemen des iLBS verbunden und ermöglicht dadurch die Bedienung von integrierten Unterzentralen (iUZ) mit ESTW/DSTW. Lot LOT-0002: Transfernetzrouter. Das Transfernetz ist Bestandteil des Systems iLBS und realisiert die Kommunikation zwischen sämtlichen Transfernetz-Teilnehmern (z. B. iBS-Z, iLBS-ZE und zentralem Verzeichnisdienst) im Gesamtsystem iLBS bis zur Vermittlungsschicht (Network Layer, OSI Schicht 3). Hierunter fallen nicht: VPN-LSTGateway-Module, sämtliche Bestandteile des Transportnetzes, der Empfänger des Zeitnormals (z. B. DCF-77) oder der Middleware-Broker. (einschließlich aller Systemkomponenten für Redundanzen). Die Komponenten werden somit sowohl am Standort des Stellwerks (TSO oder Bestandsstellwerk) als auch an den Standorten der einzelnen iBS, der BSO, eingesetzt. Lot LOT-0003: Broker und Verzeichnisdienst. Bestandteil des iLBS ist ein Netzwerk aus Broker-Servern, über das die Komponenten und Teilsysteme miteinander kommunizieren. (über Advanced Message Queuing Protocol (AMQP)). (einschließlich aller Systemkomponenten für Redundanzen). Die Broker kommen somit in den, Standorten iBS und LMC zum Einsatz. An jedem Standort wird immer ein Brokerpaar (redundante Ausführung) benötigt. Die Broker nutzen das Protokoll AMQP bzw.Red Hat JBoss Enterprise Application Plattform (JBoss EAP) als Plattform. Für die Hardware sind je physischer Broker-Instanz im Rechnerschrank je 2HE im 19 Zoll-Gestell vorgesehen. Die Einbautiefe von 700 mm darf nicht überschritten werden. Die Kühlung der Broker muss von der Frontseite erfolgen. (siehe auch Lastenheft Systemvorgaben DiB-0454). Bei dem lokalen Verzeichnisdienst handelt es sich um eine lokale Replik des Zentralen Verzeichnisdienstes, der funktional auf Lesezugriff beschränkt ist; dient als zentrale Quelle übergeordneter Informationen wie z.B. Netzwerkadressen, Bedienrelationen, Benutzerdaten und Rollen. (einschließlich aller Systemkomponenten für Redundanzen) Der lokale Verzeichnisdienst befindet sich an den iBSStandorten (BSO) und hat über das Transfernetz eine Verbindung zum zentralen Verzeichnisdienst im LMC. Aufgabe des ZVD ist die Verwaltung und Regelung von Zugriffsrechten innerhalb des iLBS. Lot LOT-0004: Lokale Lenkplanverwaltung (LLPV). Bei dem lokalen Verzeichnisdienst handelt es sich um eine lokale Replik des Zentralen Verzeichnisdienstes, der funktional auf Lesezugriff beschränkt ist; dient als zentrale Quelle übergeordneter Informationen wie z.B. Netzwerkadressen, Bedienrelationen, Benutzerdaten und Rollen. (einschließlich aller Systemkomponenten für Redundanzen) Der lokale Verzeichnisdienst befindet sich an den iBSStandorten (BSO) und hat über das Transfernetz eine Verbindung zum zentralen Verzeichnisdienst im LMC. Aufgabe des ZVD ist die Verwaltung und Regelung von Zugriffsrechten innerhalb des iLBS. Lot LOT-0005: Operative Betriebsführung des Zentralen Verzeichnisdienstes (ZVD) des LMCs und des Transfernetzes des iLBS . Die Betriebsführung für den Zentralen Verzeichnisdienst und das Transfernetz (Übertragungssystem bestehend aus Transfernetzrouter, Broker, etc.) umfasst organisatorische, technische und dokumentierende Tätigkeiten, die erforderlich sind, um die Testsysteme für geplante Tests nutzbar zu halten. Diese Systeme sind bereits in der ITU vorhanden. Eine Beschaffung der Komponenten ist nicht vorgesehen. Die Betriebsführung produktiver Systeme ist ausgeschlossen. Lot LOT-0006: Operative Betriebsführung der Zentralen Lenkplanverwaltung (LPV) für das LMC . Die Betriebsführung für die Zentrale Lenkplanverwaltung umfasst organisatorische, technische und dokumentierende Tätigkeiten, die erforderlich sind, um die Testsysteme für geplante Tests nutzbar zu halten. signals.description: The contracting authority currently has a framework agreement for development services, but the financial limit will be exhausted in the transition between the 1st and 2nd quarter of 2027. The call-offs on the contract have been significantly higher than originally expected. This is because the contract was established before the preliminary project for Digital grant management and before the extent of the further digitalisation commitment was clear. The aim of the new framework agreement is to ensure the Customer access to the necessary competence and/or capacity throughout the entire contract period. The tenderers shall be strategic cooperation partners and pro-active consultants, support the further digitalisation and contribute to solve the Contracting Authority ́s social assignment. The contract shall particularly support: The implementation of the commitment to Digital Grant Management and the development of Norad's digital platform. Development, further development and management of the Contracting Authority's data platform, including data integrations, data modelling, data quality, management information and analysis capability. • Establishment and further development of knowledge products, such as dashboards, reporting systems, insight and analysis tools, visualisations and other user interface, which makes management, case officers and other users more knowledge driven. • Reuse of data across systems and processes so that information can be used efficiently in grant management and the Contracting Authority ́s other management and reporting processes. • digitalisation of administrative services. • Use of digitalisation to strengthen the effect of Norwegian development cooperation, i.a. through better use of data, analysis and digital services for partners and other target groups. • establishment of a modern development factory where the Contracting Authority itself is in control of the deliveries. • strategic consultancy for the use of digital joint goods in the digitalisation of Norwegian assistance work.

Dieses Wissen wird heutzutage vornehmlich in Form von digitalen Informationen vorgehalten und mit Hilfe digitaler Tools verarbeitet und vermittelt. Digitalisierung geht aber weit über die digitale Repräsentation von Informationen und ihre Verarbeitung mit digitalen Methoden hinaus: Im Sinne eines synergetischen Zusammenwirkens von analog und digital ist Digitalität längst fester Bestandteil der Studien-, Forschungs-, Lehr-, Lern-, Lebens- und Arbeitsrealität an der UHH.
